single_outlet_findings.finding: Only headline in the corpus to introduce skepticism about the deal's novelty — 'but a deal already existed. So what changed?' — repositioning the story as a question of substance rather than a milestone announcement, uniquely among all 19 headlines.

Only outlet to attribute the military-expansion claim externally ('– Reuters') rather than asserting it independently, distancing itself from the factual premise while still amplifying the expansion framing.

bottom_line: At the headline layer, all ten buckets frame this as a US military buildup story (two new Arctic bases, 'permanent control'), with Trump as the named deal-maker; no headline leads with Greenland's or Denmark's perspective, and the NATO multilateral angle surfaces only in defence and Canadian press.
